name: Found
description: Found is the banking, bookkeeping, and tax platform for the self‑employed. This connector lets Claude read your Found business activity in real time. Check your available balance, break it down across pockets (including the Tax pocket Found sets aside automatically), and pull transaction history filtered by date or counterparty — each transaction comes back with method, direction, and any memo you've added. You can also ask the Found Assistant open‑ended questions about your business and get answers grounded in your actual activity.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Found to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Found to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://my.found.com/api/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Found MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Found provides these MCP tools: ask_assistant, list_accounts, list_businesses, and list_transactions.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Found?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Found in financial-services on the Manufact MCP catalog include Contract-Factory — Sociétés & SIREN, Kavara Kirk, CeylonCharts, Netzo, and Ramp Data.
Found requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Found is developed by Found. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
